note: THE single registry of farmed teaching corpora. Every consumer reads this — the app loader, the bake, the coverage report, the gates, the test harness. Adding a creator is a one-line edit HERE and nowhere else.
why: A corpus used to be registered in seven separate places. On 2026-08-14 four new farms were added to six of them and missed scripts/bake-spoken-notes.mjs, so 3,585 notes shipped wired into the app, counted in every coverage number, and unable to ever be spoken (floating notes are mute until baked). Nothing errored. One registry makes that omission impossible rather than merely unlikely. 2026-09-21 (David, emphatic: "there are only one source of corpus notes. and its the danya ones that we have tied exactly to positions. nothing else!"): the seven non-danya farmed creators were REMOVED — chessbrah, hangingpawns, saintlouis, gothamchess, hikaru, imrosen, magnuscarlsen. Measured before deleting: 47,831 notes, ZERO of them positioned, reachable only by opening NAME (16,298) and CONCEPT (47,831). The coach now has exactly two sources: danya's own corpus (122 positioned + 9,928 floating, 6,970 by name, 10,050 by concept) and the hand-authored VOICED corpus (7,477, all exact-position). Do not re-register another creator.

fields.path: repo-relative path to the corpus JSON
fields.load: 'static' = compiled into the JS bundle; 'fetch' = pulled from public/ at runtime. Large corpora MUST be fetch. Measured 2026-09-19: dist/index.html modulepreloads the entry PLUS every appdata-* chunk, so a 'static' corpus is 1:1 boot payload for every user — 32.8 MB of JS before a square is drawn.
fields.idPrefix: note-id prefix; must be unique because the coach dedupes notes by id ACROSS corpora, so a shared prefix silently drops one corpus's note
fields.primary: the house-voice corpus; its notes lead. Exactly one is true.
fields.bytes: approximate on-disk size, used ONLY to order the lazy prewarm (smallest first) so the main thread never parses two multi-MB files in one tick. farmedCorpusData DERIVES its load list from this registry rather than keeping a second copy — the hand-written copy had drifted (hangingpawns listed 9.1 MB against 4.76 MB on disk), so 'smallest first' was ordering by fiction.
fields.floatingPath: OPTIONAL second half of the SAME corpus: its notes with no position, split to public/ so they are FETCHED on demand instead of riding the boot payload (David 2026-09-19: “no more non-positioned phrases at boot”). Same key and idPrefix — one corpus, two load halves, which is why this is a field and not a second entry. NOT dead weight: measured, all 10,022 of danya's are reachable by a live tier (6,908 by opening name — the phase-transition ritual, LESSON BACKGROUND, the gap tier; 3,114 by concept — the endgame cards). Archiving them instead cut phase-transition coverage from 19/20 openings to 10/20, which is why they are fetched rather than dropped.
